cutoffs.why: Declared cut-off: the frozen TianGong snapshot has no dataset whose reference OUTPUT is diesel (or any gas-oil/light-fuel-oil equivalent), and no 'diesel burned in machinery' service. The hint flow 1cda7c03 'Diesel' shows 3 producers, but all three (1cc17669 grain drying, 585f29f8 paint furnace, 7eac9761 chamber furnace; NESPS2 CN 2019) are pollution-census coefficient sets whose reference exchange is a 1000 kg diesel INPUT with NOx/PM/SO2 outputs only (NOx ~3 g/kg, SO2 = 0, no CO2) and an unlinked 'Exhaust gas' product output. reference/lca_matrix.py (line ~125) only places ref exchanges with dir=='out' on the diagonal, so linking to any of them raises 'columns without reference output (A diagonal 0)', and build_case_bundle.py --check rejects them as 'consumes its own reference flow'. Independently reproduced every claim: no diesel (or gas-oil / light-fuel-oil / transport-service) flow in the snapshot has a usable producer; the 3 nominal producers of 1cda7c03 are input-referenced combustion coefficient sets that would zero the A diagonal and trip the bundle checker; refinery, CEEIO, crude-extraction and biodiesel datasets are not acceptable proxies; the 0.84 kg/L and 2.68 kg CO2/L factors are physically correct (IPCC 2006 / EN 590). Keep the cut-off. TianGong does contain a semantically exact flow, 'Microorganism' (725a2539-3594-448f-b0be-9c80402c594f, kg), with one producer: 'Soil Remediation; Bioreactor; Microbial Cultures; Microorganisms Cultured in the Laboratory' (eeaf8532-887c-4bc6-b689-8b47cece06c5, IT 2018, D'Imporzano et al. 2019). It is a lab starter-culture dataset: 777.6 MJ electricity (linked, 34 producers) and 2 kg 'methane' per 0.001 kg of microorganism, where the methane is coded as an INPUT of an emissions-to-water flow (no LCIA method in the snapshot characterises it in that direction). Its 0.001 kg is a nominal per-project quantity (the companion IT operation process consumes exactly 0.001 kg for a whole project), so it cannot be scaled by mass: 4,777 L at ~1 kg/L would pull in 3.7e9 MJ of electricity (16,000x the entire biopile operation, 229,320 MJ) and even the KR curators' 4.777 kg pulls in 3. … | VERIFIER: ACCEPTED. The mapper's cut-off decision is correct and every quantitative claim was reproduced from the snapshot: flow 725a2539 exists (Product flow, kg) with one producer eeaf8532 whose ref_flow matches and which does not self-consume; its 0.001 kg reference is a nominal lab batch (777.6 MJ electricity per batch), so mass-linking 4,777 kg (3.7e9 MJ) or TianGong's own mis-transcribed 4.777 kg (3.7e6 MJ) would dwarf the whole biopile operation (229,320 MJ) and invert the paper's conclusion.
